Delete the entire picture and dialogue of Premaveer visiting the prow ti Lute's house. (There is no objection to the portion where Jaganna leads him in and tells Kamukshi about the prince).
Delete the entire picture and dialogue of Premaveer in the prow ti Lute's house, his taking fright and jumping out on the mention of the king, the king’s arrival and being received.

When the minister informs Chandrakanta about the arrival of the visitor, namely, Prabhavati, delete the dialogue of his asking whether it is a woman and how old she is, and the reply that she was about 20 years old and the further statement 'I shall without fail receive her'.
When Chandrakanta enters Prabhavati's residence, delete the maids asking for payment, his question 'Is this usual fee required by you also?', giving them a ring and entering.
When Premaveer is received in the prostitute’s house, delete the question 'Is anybody else likely to come?' and the reply 'Who else is there? — either it should be the Maharajah or yourself'.

After Swayamprabha discloses to Ghandrakanta that she is his wife, delete the rest of the sequence showing his pushing her down, her weeping and pleading, her being dragged out and down, the maids, the minister and others being pushed aside and her being dragged away.
When, Chitrangi asks Chandrakanta to forget his wife, delete her statement that it was her family art to bring joy to saddened minds.

In the cell, delete the entire picture and sound of Chandrakanta pushing down and whipping Swayampraba, including the sounds off screen. (No objection to the portion up to the reference to the daily punishment; there after the next picture will show Chandrakanta coming out).
After Vijayasimha tells Swayamprabha that womankind is always like that, delete his statement 'For the pleasure of the husband, the wife will even go and be the servant of the prostitute'.

When Chandrakanta knocks on Chitrangi's door, delete the picture and dialogue showing Chitrangi and Premaveer seated on the bed and converging, and her sending him off. (Note — There is no objection to Premaveer and Kamakshi being given instructions by Chitrangi later).

Delete the entire picture and dialogue of Swayampraba being molested by the robber. (Note — There is no objection to the sequence up to Swayampraba first asking the robber and his laughter in reply and a brief insert, of taking child, for continuity. The next picture will show Swayampraba running out).

After Kamakshi, Jaganna and Chitrangi have gone on inhaling the smoke and the wanyaeis enter, delete the rest of that sequence showing them removing the jewels and silver vessels, gagging the women and running out.
When Jaganna is lamenting to Premaveer about the looting, delete the reference to the property having been earned by great effort, and the comment that it was exactly by bodily effort.

After the cobra is killed by Raja, and before he fights with the bhuta, delete the three close-up inserts of the bhuta’s face; and (b) delete the close-up of Raja on the upper portions of the bhuta’s body engaged in the final fight before the bhuta is killed, including the sounds. (Note — There is no objection to brief flash for continuity without sounds, and to the long-shot showing the full body lying down dead).
When Sanyasi inspects the contents of the portfolio stolen by Dodi, delete the sentence 'Atleast the wages should be available'.
During song No. 3, delete the picture of temple tower and worshippers at the entrance, against last two lines of the song.
When Pullia’s wife dies, reduce to half the present length, the lamentation by him, his shouting and laughing madly and knocking his head on the pillar.
When Kumar is hit on the head by Sanyasi from behind, delete the sound of his screaming. (No objection to low level sound).

During the interrogation of Situ. in the Police Station, delete all comedy by the policemen and the exposure of the policemen, and the policemen shouting at her and the words (with the accompanying gestures each time), 'shut up', 'that's good', 'damn it', 'pilla', 'stand up' and the final gesture by the policemen when Situ. goes.

Delete the picture and dialogue of Kamal a being molested by Suraiya, his closing the door and laughing, bolting the door, whispering threateningly, catching her and the tussle, her biting him and his falling and her throwing things at him. (No objection to her slapping him at first, and when at the end she throws the pot of flour on his head- The rest are to be deleted).

When the man is searching his house and smashing the pots for money to buy illicit liquor, (a) delete the picture and dialogue of his taking away the talgir from his wife, her screaming and his shouting and pushing her; (b) Delete the picture and dialogue of his coming in drunk, trampling on the sleeping child and falling on his wife, including the sounds of shouting.
